checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: One playable vertical reel runs for approximately 10 seconds.
must.why: The reply says 11.7 s at 480x858 (9:16). The clips I saw are vertical and play. I could not check the final file, and 11.7 s is a bit over 10 s.

must.item: All five supplied café photos appear recognizably in the requested order.
must.why: I only have the first two clips, storefront and interior. The storefront is recognizable but reframed, with a road added. The latte, croissants and barista clips are not shown, and the interior and barista source photos were not given to me.

must.item: Each photo has enough screen time to be recognizable, rather than appearing only as a flash.
must.why: Each clip is about 2.3 s, which is short but enough to recognize a scene.

must.item: Relaxed instrumental music is audible, with no speech or singing.
must.why: A 15 s music file exists with peak -1 dB, and the clip has a quiet audio track. I cannot judge the mood or check for vocals.

must.item: Transitions between photos are smooth, and no added text appears.
must.why: No text appears in the frames I saw. I cannot see the transitions, only the clip frames.

faults.what: The storefront shot is reframed. It adds a large road area, drops the blue door and the right side, and the awning looks different from the photo. It reads as an AI regeneration, not the original.
The interior clip shows many people with slightly soft and AI-looking faces and hands. It is a generic scene that I cannot match to a source photo.
The video runs 11.7 s against the requested 10 s, and the assistant disclosed this.
Only 2 of the 5 clips could be checked, so the rest is unverified.

summary: The two clips I could see are clean vertical shots with a storefront push-in and an interior glide, but the storefront drifted from the photo and I could not check the other three clips, the music or the transitions.
